hardInvariants.label: Semantic accessibility
hardInvariants.rule: Keep semantic structure, keyboard and touch access, visible focus, readable contrast, labels, and text scaling intact.

hardInvariants.label: Task and state completeness
hardInvariants.rule: The primary task, important non-default states, recovery path, and final state must remain understandable and actionable.

hardInvariants.label: Responsive usability
hardInvariants.rule: Re-stage the experience for the target viewport and input model; do not preserve a beautiful desktop composition by breaking mobile use.

hardInvariants.label: Asset truth and rights
hardInvariants.rule: Use user-owned, attributable, authorized, generated, or deliberate assetless media; do not present placeholders, uncertain rights, or fabricated proof as real.

hardInvariants.label: Motion safety and fallback
hardInvariants.rule: Motion needs a purpose, cleanup, reduced-motion behavior, interruption handling, and a usable static or final-state fallback.

hardInvariants.label: Performance and runtime integrity
hardInvariants.rule: Keep the target runnable, bounded, and honest about loading, failure, dependency, and performance tradeoffs.

hardInvariants.label: Rendered proof
hardInvariants.rule: Do not claim visual quality from prose or a build alone; verify the relevant rendered states and label unverified claims.

advisoryDefaults.label: AI-default composition warnings
advisoryDefaults.rule: Centered heroes, equal-card walls, repeated split sections, and uniform rounded wrappers are warnings to inspect, not universal bans.

advisoryDefaults.label: AI-default effect warnings
advisoryDefaults.rule: Gradients, glow, glass, blur, noise, oversized type, and cinematic choreography need a job, but a deliberate visual language may use them.

advisoryDefaults.label: AI-default copy and type warnings
advisoryDefaults.rule: Generic copy, display scale, and compressed metadata are suspect until the product, content, audience, and chosen direction justify them.

advisoryDefaults.label: Local candidate selection
advisoryDefaults.rule: Profiles, treatments, references, and recipes are candidates that fill gaps; they do not outrank a stronger project-owned or user-owned direction.

overrideProtocol.rule: A deliberate direction may override an advisory default when its authority source, reason, evidence, risk, preserved invariants, and rendered proof are recorded.
proof: same-viewport reference or concept comparison when applicable
non-default state and reduced-motion/static fallback check
